# Add Accounting Entry (phase 2a) — Implementation Plan

> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development (recommended) or superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax for tracking.

**Goal:** Make HomeHub the place where the owner records money: a MOZE-style entry page (phone keypad, desktop expression input), a cross-account timeline, entry detail with links, account and category settings, and a MOZE **backup** (Realm) importer that replaces the CSV path and seeds settings and reward rules, so that phase 2b can add the reward engine and statements on top.

**Architecture:** The phase 1 ledger (`account`, `category`, `project`, `ledger_entry`, `import_run`, `fx_rate`) is extended, not replaced: new tables `account_group`, `counterparty`, `entry_group`, `reward_rule`, `entry_reward_rule`, `preference`, `moze_schedule`; new columns for settings, posting date and links. A Node converter (`tools/moze-realm-export`) turns the backup zip into one JSON file; `moze_backup_json` validates it into dataclasses; `moze_backup_import_service` loads it under the shared advisory lock with the same `import_run` lifecycle as the CSV importer. Write endpoints live in small services (`entry_write_service`, `transfer_service`, `split_service`, `settlement_service`, `settings_service`) that all go through `assert_editable` (the cutover lock). The Angular SPA gets a timeline home, an entry form built from `category-picker`, `amount-keypad`, `fx-sheet`, `fee-sheet` and `split-lines`, an entry detail, account settings and an accounting settings page, all hosted by `accounting-layout`, which renders one screen on phones, a right-side sheet on tablets and two panes on desktops.

**Tech Stack:** Python 3.13, FastAPI 0.129, SQLAlchemy 2.0.49, Alembic 1.18, requests 2.32, PostgreSQL 16 (`stonk-postgres-1`), pytest 9; Node 22 with `realm@12.x` (converter only); Angular 21 standalone components with signals, PrimeNG 21 (dialogs/inputs where already used), Vitest via `ng test`.

**Spec:** `openspec/changes/add-accounting-entry/` (`proposal.md`, `design.md` D12–D27, `specs/accounting-ledger/spec.md`, `specs/accounting-moze-backup-import/spec.md`, `specs/accounting-moze-import/spec.md`, `specs/frontend-accounting-ledger/spec.md`, `specs/frontend-app-shell/spec.md`, `mockups.html`). Phase 1 decisions D1–D11 are in `openspec/changes/archive/2026-10-02-rebuild-accounting-moze-ledger/design.md`.

**In-service API paths.** `frontend/proxy.conf.js` and Caddy strip `/api/accounting`, so routers serve the paths without the prefix (e.g. public `POST /api/accounting/entries` is `POST /entries` in the service).

**Worktree:** `/home/opc/workspace/home-hub-entry`, branch `feat/accounting-entry` (already created, with the spec commits). All commands run from there. This shell aliases `rm` and `cp` to interactive forms; use `git rm`, `rm -f` and `command cp`. The root `.env` is symlinked at the worktree root already; never print it.

## Global Constraints

- `amount` is `NUMERIC(20,4)`; positive increases the account balance, negative decreases it; `currency` is copied from the account at insert and `amount` is always in that currency. Amounts with more than 4 decimals SHALL be rejected.
- An account's balance SHALL be `opening_balance + Σ ledger_entry.amount` over its entries whose `posted_date` is not after today. `posted_date` defaults to `entry_date`.
- The canonical order (`entry_date`, `entry_time` NULLS FIRST, `seq`) is unchanged; running balances, pagination and listings use it or its exact reverse.
- `currency` SHALL NOT change while the account has any entry, by edit or by import (any `source`).
- The credit-only fields `due_rule`, `due_value`, `credit_limit`, `combined_account_id`, `credit_sharing_id` and `auto_pay_account_id` SHALL be NULL unless `is_credit` is TRUE; `closing_day` and the `fx_fee_*` fields are allowed on any account. `combined_account_id` SHALL NOT point at the account itself and SHALL NOT form a cycle.
- While `ACCOUNTING_IMPORT_LOCKED` is false, any `PUT`, `DELETE`, settle or refund request targeting an entry or entry group whose `source` is `moze_import` or `moze_backup`, or whose `moze_id` is set, SHALL be refused with HTTP 409 and the message `locked_until_cutover`. Account settings writes are always allowed. When the flag is true, every row is editable and imports are refused.
- Manual rows (`source = 'manual'`) SHALL be editable at all times and SHALL never be deleted by an import; neither are `hermes` or `rule` rows.
- Every write SHALL set `source = 'manual'` and SHALL update `category.default_account_id` and `default_project_id` to the values used.
- Transfers: each leg of a cross-currency transfer stores the other leg's amount, carrying this leg's sign, as `original_amount` / `original_currency`, with `fx_rate = |amount| / |original_amount|` rounded half-up to 10 decimals; the amounts are the source of truth; consistency checks use a tolerance of half a displayed unit (0.5 for TWD and JPY, 0.005 otherwise), never exact equality.
- Settlements and refunds are allowed only on accounts in the original entry's currency (HTTP 422 otherwise). Counterparty `open_amounts` are per currency: `−Σ amount` over that counterparty's `receivable` and `payable` entries in that currency.
- Imports: every entry point (CLI and REST, both importers) takes the one advisory lock `IMPORT_LOCK_KEY = 0x4D4F5A45`; a refused import writes nothing; dry runs take the lock and write nothing; `ACCOUNTING_IMPORT_LOCKED = true` refuses every import. Each full replace deletes every `ledger_entry` and `entry_group` whose `source` is `moze_import` or `moze_backup` or whose `moze_id` is set, together with their `entry_reward_rule` rows; `reward_rule` rows are upserted by `moze_id` and never deleted while referenced; the CSV importer never touches rules.
- Backup import record mapping (`AHRecord.type` → kind): 0 expense, 1 income, 2 transfer_out / transfer_in by `isTransferIn`, 3 receivable, 5 receivable (collection), 4 payable, 6 payable (repayment), 7 balance_adjustment, 12 and 16 fee, 13 discount, 14 reward, 15 interest; any other type fails the import. `total = price + fee + bonus`; `fee ≠ 0` becomes a `fee` child, `bonus ≠ 0` a `discount` child. Rows dated after the archive's export date are skipped and preserved in `moze_schedule`.
- Backup FX: when the record currency differs from the account currency and the account currency is the main currency and the record has a `currencyConversion`, `amount = price × exchangeRate` (half-up, 4 dp), `fx_source = 'moze_backup'`; otherwise the `fx_rate` cache (`fx_source = 'fx_api'`). Each `moze_backup` conversion is sanity-checked against the cached daily rate within 25 % unless `--allow-fx-outliers`.
- Strict mode compares `moze_part` (opening + Σ `moze_backup` entries posted ≤ the backup's cache date) only on accounts with a confirmed comparable cached balance; `balanceInfo` is treated as not comparable unless the first implementation task finds the exact rule; the report header states `compared_accounts: N of M`; the CLI warns when N is 0; `previous_moze_part` is a difference check, not a verification; the manual check stays in acceptance.
- Frontend: every accounting page usable at 390 px without horizontal page scrolling; < 760 px one screen per route; 760–1023 px one pane with a right-side sheet; ≥ 1024 px two persistent panes; selecting a row updates the right pane and the URL without a page navigation. Breakpoint 760 px exactly (shell).
- TWD and JPY display as whole units (half away from zero), other currencies up to 2 decimals; display-only rounding (`formatAmount`).
- Owner data rule: `~/workspace/moze-backup/MOZE_4.0.zip` and `~/workspace/MOZE_20261001_170037.csv` are private; never copied into the repo, committed, or printed row by row. Tests use synthetic fixtures built in the tests. Tests never reach the network (autouse `no_network` fixture blocks `requests.get`; pass `fake_http`). Tests never run the real Node converter against the real backup; the real backup is used only in the acceptance task (Task 11) against a disposable database, reporting aggregates.
- Commit after every task with a Conventional Commits subject (`feat(accounting): …`, `feat(frontend): …`, `test(...)`, `docs(...)`) and the trailer `Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5.1 <noreply@anthropic.com>`.

## Review Focus

1. **Balance uses `posted_date`, running balance uses canonical order.** A reward posted next month must not move today's balance but must appear in the passbook in canonical order with a running balance that includes it only when posted — pinned by `test_future_posted_entry_excluded_from_balance_but_listed` (Task 4).
2. **Lock bypass through side doors.** Settle, refund and split-member edits on a locked target must be refused like `PUT`; a manual child of an imported parent cannot exist, so the check runs on the target entry and on every member of a group — pinned by `test_settle_and_refund_refuse_locked_target` (Task 15) and `test_split_update_refuses_locked_group` (Task 14).
3. **Re-import with manual entries and rules.** A second backup import must keep manual entries, their attachments and the rule ids, must not duplicate groups, categories, counterparties or rules, and must refuse a currency change while any entry remains — pinned by `test_reimport_keeps_manual_entries_attachments_and_rule_ids` and `test_reimport_refuses_currency_change_with_remaining_entries` (Task 10).
4. **Keypad and expression evaluator.** `3×40`, `100÷3`, `−` as unary, trailing operator, `00`, a second `=` and a locale with full-width digits must not produce NaN or a wrong sign — pinned by `evaluates precedence, division rounding, unary minus and trailing operators` (Task 19).
5. **Two-pane URL sync.** Selecting a row on desktop must update the URL to `/accounting/entries/{id}` without re-creating the list, and a direct load of that URL at ≥ 1024 px must show list and detail — pinned by `keeps the list and updates the URL when a row is selected at 1280px` (Task 21).

## Known Spec Conflicts

None open. Two implementation-time confirmations are called out in the spec and recorded by Task 11: the `AHAccount.paymentDeadlineType` → `due_rule` map and the `rewardCalculation` → rounding map; `balanceInfo` is treated as not comparable unless Task 11 finds the rule.

## Interface Contract

Every task's "Interfaces" block refers to these names. Implementers use them verbatim; reviewers reject deviations.

### Enums (Postgres enum names in parentheses)

- `ENTRY_SOURCES = ("moze_import", "moze_backup", "manual", "hermes", "rule")` (`entry_source`)
- `FX_SOURCES = ("fx_api", "moze_backup", "manual")` (`fx_source`)
- `DUE_RULES = ("fixed_day", "days_after_closing")` (`due_rule`)
- `ROUNDING_MODES = ("keep", "round", "floor", "ceil")` (`rounding_mode`)
- `ENTRY_GROUP_KINDS = ("split", "reward_claim", "installment")` (`entry_group_kind`)
- `REWARD_METHODS = ("percent", "fixed")` (`reward_method`); `REWARD_WINDOWS = ("statement_cycle",)` (`reward_window`); `REWARD_POSTINGS = ("after_window", "after_transaction", "manual")` (`reward_posting`)
- `COLOR_CONVENTIONS = ("red_green", "green_red")` (`color_convention`); `KEYPAD_LAYOUTS = ("calculator", "phone")` (`keypad_layout`)
- `SCHEDULE_KINDS = ("period", "installment", "skipped_record")` (`moze_schedule_kind`)
- `IMPORT_KINDS = ("moze_csv", "moze_backup")` (`import_kind`)

### Models (`app/models/ledger.py` unless noted)

```python
class AccountGroup(Base):            # account_group
    id, name: String(64) unique, sort_order: Integer default 0, moze_id: String(64) unique nullable

class Account(Base, TimestampMixin): # account — phase 1 columns plus:
    group_id -> account_group.id nullable; icon String(16); color String(9); note Text; sort_order Integer default 0
    include_in_total Boolean default true; is_credit Boolean default false; closing_day SmallInteger nullable
    due_rule due_rule nullable; due_value SmallInteger nullable; credit_limit Numeric(20,4) nullable
    combined_account_id -> account.id nullable; credit_sharing_id Uuid nullable; auto_pay_account_id -> account.id nullable
    fx_fee_pct Numeric(6,3) nullable; fx_fee_rounding rounding_mode nullable; fx_fee_refundable Boolean default false
    settings_locally_edited Boolean default false; moze_id String(64) unique nullable
    CheckConstraint: closing_day BETWEEN 1 AND 31; combined_account_id <> id

class Category(Base):                # category — plus icon String(16), color String(9), sort_order Integer default 0,
                                     # is_hidden Boolean default false, default_account_id -> account.id, default_project_id -> project.id, moze_id unique nullable
class Project(Base):                 # project — plus is_archived Boolean default false, sort_order Integer default 0, moze_id unique nullable
class Counterparty(Base):            # counterparty: id, name String(128) unique, moze_id unique nullable
class EntryGroup(Base):              # entry_group: id, kind entry_group_kind, name String(128), merchant String(128), description Text, moze_id unique nullable, created_at
class RewardRule(Base):              # reward_rule: id, account_id -> account.id, name String(128), method reward_method, rate Numeric(8,4), fixed_amount Numeric(20,4),
                                     # window reward_window default 'statement_cycle', posting reward_posting, delay_days SmallInteger default 0, post_month_offset SmallInteger default 0,
                                     # post_day SmallInteger default 1, txn_rounding rounding_mode default 'keep', total_rounding rounding_mode default 'keep', total_cap Numeric(20,4),
                                     # shared_cap_id Uuid, is_basic Boolean default false, reward_account_id -> account.id, reward_project_id -> project.id, starts_on Date, ends_on Date,
                                     # is_enabled Boolean default true, description Text, sort_order Integer default 0, moze_id unique nullable
class EntryRewardRule(Base):         # entry_reward_rule: entry_id -> ledger_entry.id ON DELETE CASCADE, rule_id -> reward_rule.id ON DELETE RESTRICT; composite PK
class LedgerEntry(Base):             # ledger_entry — phase 1 columns minus `counterparty`, plus posted_date Date not null, counterparty_id -> counterparty.id, group_id -> entry_group.id,
                                     # settles_entry_id -> ledger_entry.id, refunds_entry_id -> ledger_entry.id, reward_rule_id -> reward_rule.id, reward_source_entry_id -> ledger_entry.id,
                                     # invoice_number String(16), invoice_random String(8), moze_id String(64) unique nullable, updated_at
class Preference(Base):              # preference: id Integer PK (always 1), expense_income_colors color_convention, keypad_layout keypad_layout, week_start SmallInteger,
                                     # main_currency String(8), hide_rewards_on_timeline Boolean, abbreviate_totals Boolean
class MozeSchedule(Base):            # moze_schedule: id, kind moze_schedule_kind, moze_id String(64), payload JSONB, import_run_id -> import_run.id
class ImportRun(Base):               # app/models/import_run.py — plus kind import_kind default 'moze_csv', exported_at DateTime(timezone=True) nullable
```

Indexes on `ledger_entry`: existing ones plus `(account_id, posted_date)`, `(entry_date)`, `counterparty_id`, `group_id`, `settles_entry_id`, `reward_source_entry_id`.

### Pydantic schemas (`app/schemas/writes.py`)

```python
class ChildIn(BaseModel): amount: Decimal (unsigned, > 0); name: str | None
class EntryIn(BaseModel):
    account_id: int; kind: Literal["expense","income","receivable","payable"]; amount: Decimal (unsigned) | None = None
    original_amount: Decimal | None = None; original_currency: str | None = None; fx_rate: Decimal | None = None
    entry_date: date; entry_time: time | None = None; posted_date: date | None = None
    category_id: int | None = None; project_id: int | None = None; name: str | None = None; merchant: str | None = None
    counterparty_id: int | None = None; description: str | None = None; tags: list[str] = []
    invoice_number: str | None = None; invoice_random: str | None = None
    fee: ChildIn | None = None; discount: ChildIn | None = None; reward_rule_ids: list[int] = []
class EntryUpdateIn(EntryIn): pass
class TransferIn(BaseModel): from_account_id: int; to_account_id: int; out_amount: Decimal; in_amount: Decimal | None = None; entry_date: date; entry_time: time | None; posted_date: date | None
    category_id: int | None; name, merchant, description: str | None; project_id: int | None; tags: list[str] = []
    out_fee, out_discount, in_fee, in_discount: ChildIn | None; reward_rule_ids: list[int] = []
class SplitIn(BaseModel): name: str | None; merchant: str | None; description: str | None; entry_date: date; entry_time: time | None; posted_date: date | None
    project_id: int | None; tags: list[str] = []; members: list[EntryIn] (min 1; member date/time/posted/project/tags default to the group's)
class SettleIn(BaseModel): account_id: int; amount: Decimal; entry_date: date; entry_time: time | None; description: str | None
class RefundIn(BaseModel): account_id: int | None; amount: Decimal; entry_date: date; entry_time: time | None; description: str | None
class BalanceAdjustmentIn(BaseModel): account_id: int; target_balance: Decimal; entry_date: date; entry_time: time | None; description: str | None
class AccountIn(BaseModel): name, currency, opening_balance, is_archived, group_id, icon, color, note, sort_order, include_in_total, is_credit, closing_day, due_rule, due_value, credit_limit, combined_account_id, credit_sharing_id, auto_pay_account_id, fx_fee_pct, fx_fee_rounding, fx_fee_refundable
class AccountGroupIn(BaseModel): name: str; sort_order: int = 0
class CategoryIn(BaseModel): kind: str; parent_id: int | None; name: str; icon: str | None; color: str | None; sort_order: int = 0; is_hidden: bool = False
class ProjectIn(BaseModel): name: str; is_archived: bool = False; sort_order: int = 0
class CounterpartyIn(BaseModel): name: str
class PreferenceIn(BaseModel): expense_income_colors, keypad_layout, week_start, main_currency, hide_rewards_on_timeline, abbreviate_totals
class OrderIn(BaseModel): ids: list[int]
```

## Contract additions (merged: sections A, C, D, E after reconciliation)

These extend the backbone "Interface Contract". Where a section's earlier draft disagreed, the producer's definition below wins (backend over frontend).

### Backend: models

- `app.models.ledger.MOZE_SOURCES = ("moze_import", "moze_backup")`, exported from `app.models` (Task 2). It is the only definition. `edit_lock.MOZE_SOURCES` re-exports it, and `ledger_service.is_locked` and `edit_lock.is_moze_sourced` both use it.
- `ledger_entry.settles_entry_id`, `refunds_entry_id` and `reward_source_entry_id` are `ON DELETE SET NULL`, so the database clears links when the target is deleted.
- `ledger_entry.posted_date` is filled by the trigger `trg_ledger_entry_posted_date` (`BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE`, `COALESCE(posted_date, entry_date)`). The column is declared with `server_default=FetchedValue()`. Writers may pass `None`. C's writers pass `payload.posted_date or payload.entry_date` (or the parent's date), which works with the trigger.
- Extra check constraints: `ck_reward_rule_post_month_offset` (0–2), `ck_reward_rule_post_day` (1–31), `ck_preference_single_row` (`id = 1`), `ck_preference_week_start` (0–6). Index: `ix_reward_rule_account_id`.
- Alembic head `7b1e4a2c9d05` (Task 3). The downgrade guard refuses whenever phase 1 cannot hold the data.

## Requirements for part B (Tasks 6–11)

1. **`ScheduleItemOut`** (`GET /imports/schedules?kind=`, returning `list[ScheduleItemOut]`) must serialize exactly these fields:
   - `id: int`;
   - `kind`: `"period" | "installment" | "skipped_record"`;
   - `moze_id: str` (non-null);
   - `name: str | None`;
   - `next_date: date | None`;
   - `amount: Decimal | None`: signed, serialized as a decimal string;
   - `currency: str | None`.
   Derive `name`, `next_date`, `amount` and `currency` from `moze_schedule.payload` when the row is written or read. `kind` is optional and filters the list.
2. **`ImportRun.kind` and `ImportRun.exported_at`** on `app/models/import_run.py`:
   - `kind: import_kind` defaults to `'moze_csv'`; backup runs write `'moze_backup'`.
   - `exported_at: DateTime(timezone=True)` is nullable.
   - Task 2 declares both columns and Task 3 migrates them; B only writes them.
   - The import-run output used by `POST /imports/moze-backup` and `GET /imports/latest` must include `kind`, alongside the phase 1 fields `id`, `status` (`running | succeeded | failed | dry_run`), `started_at`, `finished_at`, `file_name`, `file_sha256`, `row_count`, `summary`.
3. **`POST /imports/moze-backup`**:
   - accepts multipart `file` (≤ 200 MB), form `renames` (a JSON object string `{"old": "new"}`, may be empty, as in phase 1's `POST /imports/moze`) and query `dry_run`, `strict`, `allow_fx_outliers` (the frontend always sends `dry_run` and `strict`);
   - returns the import-run shape above, with the report under `summary`; a dry run returns `status = "dry_run"`;
   - errors (same as phase 1): 423 when `import_locked()`, 409 when the advisory lock is busy, 400 for malformed `renames`, 422 for a bad archive (shared_lib body).
4. **`MOZE_SOURCES`**: import it from `app.models` (Task 2). Do not define another tuple. Backup rows use `source = 'moze_backup'` and set `moze_id`, so `ledger_service.is_locked(source, moze_id)` and `edit_lock.is_moze_sourced` treat them as locked until cutover.
5. **`is_locked` and `import_locked`**:
   - Reuse `ledger_service.is_locked(source, moze_id) -> bool` (Task 4) for any lock flag in reports.
   - Read the cutover flag through `edit_lock.import_locked()`. Task 12 moves it there and `moze_import_service` re-exports it, so the backup importer can import either name.
   - If B lands before Task 12, use `moze_import_service.import_locked` and keep that import path working.
6. **Test scaffolding to build on** (do not redefine):
   - `tests.helpers.make_account(session, name="錢包", currency="TWD", opening="0", **columns)` and `make_entry(session, account, amount, *, kind="expense", entry_date=date(2026, 9, 1), entry_time=None, source="manual", **columns)`;
   - `conftest.LEDGER_TABLES` from Task 3, which already covers `moze_schedule`, `reward_rule`, `entry_reward_rule`, `entry_group`, `counterparty`, `account_group` and `preference`; B adds no tables;
   - the autouse `no_network` fixture and `fake_http`;
   - Task 12's `seed` fixture, if B's tests run after Task 12;
   - B's conftest and helpers edits, if any, must be exact old→new edits against the files as Tasks 3, 4 and 12 leave them.
7. **Errors and schemas**:
   - Use `app/services/errors.py`'s `ValidationError` / `ConflictError` (Task 12) only if B lands after Task 12. Otherwise raise `MozeImportError` / `ConverterError` and map them in `imports.py`.
   - Never return a list `detail` through `HTTPException`; shared_lib stringifies it.
   - Append any new Pydantic outputs (`ScheduleItemOut`, the backup report) to `app/schemas/ledger.py` or B's own module; do not recreate `app/schemas/writes.py`.
8. **Report summary keys**: use the backbone list, verbatim and nested as described there, because `BackupImportReport` / `summarizeReport` read them:
   - `kind`, `exported_at`, `kind_counts`, `skipped_future`, `groups`, `transfers`, `rules`, `attachments`, `counterparties`;
   - `needs_review` as `{count, reasons}`, `unsupported_rules`, `orphaned_rules`, `settings_skipped`;
   - `accounts[]` with `name`, `currency`, `balance`, `moze_part`, `previous_moze_part`, `moze_balance`, `difference`, `compared`;
   - `compared_accounts` as `{compared, total}`, `fx_outliers`, `confirmed_maps`, `accounts_created`, `accounts_archived`;
   - `accounts_renamed` as `[{from, to}]`.
   Decimals are serialized as strings.
9. **Settings and rules written by the importer** must fit A's models and constraints:
   - `reward_rule` limits: `post_month_offset` 0–2, `post_day` 1–31;
   - `preference` is a single row with `id = 1` and `week_start` 0–6;
   - reward rules are upserted by `moze_id` and never deleted while referenced;
   - `posted_date` may be left None (the trigger fills it).
10. **Converter and CLI** (Tasks 30–31 depend on them):
    - `tools/moze-realm-export/index.js`, installed with `npm ci` from a committed lock file;
    - the `MOZE_REALM_EXPORTER` override, documented in `.env.example` next to `ACCOUNTING_IMPORT_LOCKED`;
    - the CLI `python -m app.services.moze_backup_import_service <zip> [--dry-run] [--rename OLD=NEW ...] [--allow-fx-outliers] [--no-strict] [--keep-json PATH]` prints the JSON report to stdout and exits 0 on success.

## Part B (Tasks 6–11) additions, after reconciliation

### Backend: import services

- `moze_import_service` (Tasks 8 and 10): imports `MOZE_SOURCES` from `app.models` (never redefines it). Adds:
  - `delete_moze_entries(session)`: deletes entries of either MOZE source or with a `moze_id`, their `entry_reward_rule` rows and groups with a `moze_id`. It never touches `reward_rule`.
  - `assert_currency_change_allowed(session, account, currency)`: raises `MozeImportError("account '<name>': currency A → B refused, …")` while any entry remains.
  - `delete_unused_rows(session, keep=None)` replaces `_delete_unused_categories_and_projects`. It also deletes unused counterparties and keeps rows with a `moze_id` (`keep=None`) or whose `moze_id` is still in the backup.
  - `import_lock(engine)`: context manager holding the shared advisory lock (`IMPORT_LOCK_KEY`). It raises `ImportLockedError` when `import_locked()` and `ImportAlreadyRunningError` when the lock is busy. Only the two importers use it; the write services of Tasks 12–16 do not.
  - `mark_interrupted_runs(session)`.
  - `run_report(run)` and the CSV dry-run report add `kind` and `exported_at` (ISO string or null).
  - The CSV writer sets `posted_date = entry_date` and `kind = 'moze_csv'`. Task 2 step 2.6 makes the CSV importer resolve 對象 to `counterparty` rows (`_Lookup.counterparty_id`), and Task 10 step 10.6 anchors on that text.
- `import_locked`: B reads it from `moze_import_service` (`import_lock`, `run_import`, `run_backup_import`). Task 12 moves the definition to `edit_lock` and re-exports it from `moze_import_service`, and its delete anchor matches the file as Task 10 leaves it.
- `moze_backup_import_service` (Tasks 8–10):
  - `SOURCE = "moze_backup"`, `SYSTEM_ACCOUNT_TYPES = (3, 4)`, `MAX_BACKUP_BYTES`;
  - `ConverterError(MozeImportError)`, `exporter_command()`, `convert_backup(zip_path, work_dir, exporter=None, timeout=600) -> Path`;
  - `replace_ledger_from_backup(session, data, import_run_id, renames, rates, *, strict, allow_fx_outliers) -> dict`;
  - `run_backup_import(engine, zip_path, file_name, *, dry_run=False, renames=None, strict=True, allow_fx_outliers=False, http_get=None, exporter=None, keep_json=None) -> dict`;
  - `list_schedules(db, kind=None) -> list[dict]`;
  - `balance_info_key` hook (default `None`);
  - `main(argv=None, *, engine=None, exporter=None) -> int`.
  - Backup rows have `source = 'moze_backup'` and `moze_id` set, so `ledger_service.is_locked` and `edit_lock.is_moze_sourced` lock them.
- `moze_backup_json` (Task 7): `parse_backup_doc`, `load_backup_json`, `record_kind`, `RECORD_TYPE_TO_KIND` and the maps listed in plan B's contract additions.

### Backend: schemas and routes

- `app/schemas/imports.py`:
  - `ImportReport` gains `kind: Literal["moze_csv", "moze_backup"] = "moze_csv"` and `exported_at: datetime | None = None`. These read A's `ImportRun.kind` and `ImportRun.exported_at`.
  - `ScheduleItemOut` is exactly `{id: int, kind: "period" | "installment" | "skipped_record", moze_id: str, name: str | None, next_date: date | None, amount: Decimal | None, currency: str | None}`, ordered by `next_date` (nulls last), then `id`. `payload` stays in `moze_schedule` and is not returned. `currency` is the payload's `currency`, else the currency of the payload's `account` (matched by `moze_id`), else `ledger_service.main_currency`.
- `POST /imports/moze-backup` takes:
  - multipart `file`;
  - form `renames`: a **JSON object string** `{"old name": "new name"}`, the same as `POST /imports/moze`. Empty means no renames, and a non-object is 400. This supersedes "`OLD=NEW` lines" in requirement 3; D's `BackupImportOptions.renames` comment is updated to match.
  - query `dry_run`, `strict` (default true) and `allow_fx_outliers`.
- It returns `ImportReport`. Errors follow the phase 1 CSV endpoint:

| Status | When |
|---|---|
| 423 | `ACCOUNTING_IMPORT_LOCKED=true`; not 409 as requirement 3 said |
| 409 | the advisory lock is busy |
| 413 | the upload is over 200 MB |
| 422 | converter or import failure |
| 400 | bad `renames` |

  Every body is the shared_lib string `detail`.
- Router dependency `get_backup_exporter() -> list[str] | None`, which tests override with `fake_exporter(...)`. Also `MAX_BACKUP_UPLOAD_BYTES`.
- `GET /imports/schedules?kind=` returns `list[ScheduleItemOut]`; an unknown `kind` is 422. `GET /imports/latest` returns `kind` and `exported_at`.

### Backup report summary (`import_run.summary` / `report["summary"]`), exact shapes

All decimals are strings with 4 dp.

- `kind: "moze_backup"`; `exported_at: str` (ISO 8601 with +08:00).
- `kind_counts: {<entry kind>: int}`, sorted by kind.
- `skipped_future: {<MOZE AHRecord.type code as string>: int}`, for example `{"6": 1, "15": 1}`. It is keyed by type code, not by entry kind. E's `summarizeReport` maps the codes to kinds with `RECORD_TYPE_TO_KIND` and merges codes that share a kind.
- `schedules: {"period"|"installment"|"skipped_record": int}`.
- `groups`, `transfers`, `transfer_rate_mismatches`, `rules`, `attachments`, `counterparties`: int.
- `needs_review: {count: int, reasons: {<reason>: int}}`. The reasons are `disabled_record`, `unpaired_transfer`, `reward_rule_missing`, `reward_source_missing` and `refund_original_missing`.
- `unsupported_rules: [{name, account, reasons: [str]}]`; `orphaned_rules: [{name, account}]`.
- `settings_skipped: [{name, differences: ["<column>: <backup> → kept <local>"]}]`.
- `accounts: [{name, currency, balance, moze_part, previous_moze_part: str|null, moze_balance: str|null, difference: str|null, compared: bool}]`.
- `compared_accounts: {compared: int, total: int}`; `not_compared: [account name]`.
- `fx_outliers: [{moze_id, date, currency, moze_rate, cached_rate}]`.
- `confirmed_maps`:
  - `due_rule: {code: str}` and `rounding: {code: str}`;
  - `refund_direction`: `refund_record_points_to_original | original_points_to_refund | shared_refund_id | null`;
  - `tag_delimiter: str|null`;
  - `balance_info_key: str|null`.
- `accounts_created: [name]`, `accounts_archived: [name]`, `accounts_renamed: [{from, to}]`.
- On failure the run's summary is `{"error": str}`.

## Plan-review additions (2026-10-02, after the owner's plan review)

- **Account period summary** (Task 4 produces, Task 18 wraps, Task 26 consumes): `ledger_service.period_summary(db, account_id: int, date_from: date, date_to: date) -> dict` and `GET /accounts/{account_id}/summary?date_from=&date_to=` → `AccountPeriodSummaryOut {account_id, currency, date_from, date_to, spend (Σ negative amounts of kinds expense/fee, as a negative Decimal), income (Σ positive amounts of kinds income/interest/discount), rewards (Σ reward amounts), net (Σ all amounts in the period), end_balance (balance as of date_to, posted_date based), count}`. Dates filter on `posted_date`. Frontend: `AccountingService.getAccountSummary(accountId, dateFrom, dateTo): Observable<AccountPeriodSummary>` with the same keys as decimal strings. The passbook header uses this endpoint, never the loaded page.
- **`AccountingService.accountsChanged: Signal<number>`** (Task 18): bumped after every successful `createAccount`, `updateAccount`, `deleteAccount`, `resetSettingsFlag`, account-group write and non-dry-run backup import. List pages (`AccountingAccountsComponent`) reload on change, as the timeline does on `entriesChanged`.
- **Request sequencing in pane pages** (Tasks 23, 27): every load keeps a `requestId` (or `switchMap` on `paramMap`); a response whose id is not the latest is dropped; `saving` is disabled while `loading()` is true; tests flush responses in reverse order and assert the form shows the latest id's data and the save targets it.
- **Settlement and refund entries are not editable through `PUT /entries/{id}`** (Task 12): an entry with `settles_entry_id` or of kind `refund` returns 422 `kind` on `PUT`; its amount, account and date change only by delete + re-settle / re-refund. The original of settlements or refunds cannot change `amount`, `account_id`, `kind` or `currency` while `settled_by` / `refunded_by` is non-empty (422 naming the field).
- **Row locking for settle and refund** (Task 15): `settle` and `refund` run `SELECT … FOR UPDATE` on the target entry inside the request transaction before computing the open or refundable amount; a concurrency test with two engine connections proves the second request sees the first's write (422 over-settlement) rather than double-settling.
- **Shared credit limit membership** (Task 27 + Task 16): the account settings form sends the full member list; the backend `update_account` with `credit_sharing_members: list[int] | None` in `AccountIn` (optional; when present, the set `{account} ∪ members` gets one `credit_sharing_id` and every other account that previously carried that id is cleared) applies the diff atomically. `AccountIn.credit_sharing_members` is added in Task 16 and documented in `AccountInput`.
- **Rollback (Task 3 guard + Task 30 runbook)**: the downgrade guard stays strict (refuses when any row would be lost: `manual`/`hermes`/`rule` entries, `moze_backup` entries, groups, rules, schedules, `import_run.kind = 'moze_backup'`); the runbook's rollback is therefore **restore from the pre-deploy dump**: `pg_dump -Fc accounting_db` to `~/backups/home-hub-2a/<timestamp>.dump` before `alembic upgrade`, plus the previous backend commit and SPA release id; the runbook includes a restore drill against a disposable database before the production deploy and a 3-day window note.
- **Owner balance acceptance** (Task 11 + Task 31): Task 11 runs on the disposable `accounting_backup_verify` database and produces the 10-account checklist; the owner completes it in Task 31 on the verify server (same data, date of the backup export), recording pass/fail per account (initials only) in the PR description; the task passes only when all 10 match and the 9 FX-converted accounts are within the owner's accepted differences.
- **Edit mode keeps archived accounts** (Task 23): the form loads `getAccounts(true)`; the account select lists non-archived accounts plus the entry's current account when archived (labelled 已封存).

## Plan-review round 2 additions (2026-10-02)

- **Settlement identity is explicit** (Task 2 model, Task 3 migration, Task 9 import, Task 12/15 writes): `ledger_entry.is_settlement BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT false`. Set to true by `settlement_service.settle` and by the backup importer for `AHRecord.type` 5 (collection) and 6 (repayment), regardless of whether a link to the original exists. Check constraint `ck_ledger_entry_settlement_sign`: `(kind = 'receivable' AND amount > 0) OR (kind = 'payable' AND amount < 0)` implies `is_settlement`, and `is_settlement` implies `kind IN ('receivable','payable')`. `EntryOut` and `LedgerEntry` (frontend) gain `is_settlement: bool`. `PUT /entries/{id}` refuses when `is_settlement` is true (422 `kind`), independent of `settles_entry_id`. Counterparty open amounts and `open_amount` keep summing by sign; `settled_by` lists entries with `settles_entry_id` only.
- **Locking on the original for every mutation** (Task 12): `update_entry` and `delete_entry` resolve FX (which may write the `fx_rate` cache and commit through its own session, so it runs first) and then load the target with `SELECT … FOR UPDATE`; inside the lock they re-run `has_settlements_or_refunds` and the field guards. `settle` and `refund` already lock the same row, so a concurrent PUT either sees the settlement or blocks until it is committed. Race test: `test_update_blocks_until_concurrent_settlement_commits` (PUT amount change vs. settle on two sessions; PUT ends in 422).
- **Protected fields on a settled or refunded original** now include `counterparty_id` (422 `counterparty_id`).
- **Shared-limit membership marks every touched account** (Task 16): `_apply_sharing` sets `settings_locally_edited = true` on the account and on every member added or removed. The settings form's 額度共用 options come from `getAccounts(true)` so archived members can be removed (labelled 已封存).
- **Balance as-of date** (Task 4, Task 18, Task 31): `GET /accounts?as_of=YYYY-MM-DD` and `GET /accounts/{id}?as_of=` compute `balance`, `balance_main`, `available_credit` with `posted_date ≤ as_of` (default today). `ledger_service.list_accounts(db, *, include_archived=False, as_of: date | None = None)`, `get_account(db, account_id, *, as_of=None)`. Frontend `getAccounts(includeArchived = false, asOf?: string)` and `getAccount(id, asOf?: string)` pass `as_of` when given. Task 11's checklist values are the report's `moze_part` (as of the backup's cache/export date); Task 31 verifies with `curl "…/accounts?as_of=<exported_at>"` that the API equals the checklist, and the owner compares the checklist with MOZE at that date; the UI balance (today) is informational only.
- **Load sequencing covers dependent loads** (Tasks 23, 24, 27): the navigation `switchMap` chain loads the entry detail AND its group members (split) or transfer counterpart with `forkJoin` before `loading` becomes false; saving is disabled until then; `resetSettingsFlag` and any post-save refetch are chained inside the same sequence and discarded when `loadId` changed. Tests: `does not save a split until its members have loaded`, `ignores a reset-settings response that arrives after switching accounts`.
- **Rollback by database swap** (Task 30): `pg_restore --clean` into the live database fails on the 2a foreign keys (verified). Procedure: `createdb accounting_db_restore` → `pg_restore -d accounting_db_restore <dump>` → `pm2 stop accounting-service` → in `psql`: `ALTER DATABASE accounting_db RENAME TO accounting_db_broken_<ts>; ALTER DATABASE accounting_db_restore RENAME TO accounting_db;` (no connections may exist; the rename is atomic) → previous backend commit → `pm2 start` → republish previous SPA → Caddy line. The drill before deploy runs on a disposable copy that has been upgraded AND holds 2a data (run the migration and a dry-run-free backup import into it), restores the dump into a second disposable database, swaps names, and checks `alembic current` and row counts. `accounting_db_broken_<ts>` is dropped only after the 3-day window.

**Interfaces:**

- Produces: enum tuples `ENTRY_SOURCES`, `MOZE_SOURCES = ("moze_import", "moze_backup")`, `FX_SOURCES`, `DUE_RULES`, `ROUNDING_MODES`, `ENTRY_GROUP_KINDS`, `REWARD_METHODS`, `REWARD_WINDOWS`, `REWARD_POSTINGS`, `COLOR_CONVENTIONS`, `KEYPAD_LAYOUTS`, `SCHEDULE_KINDS` (in `app.models.ledger`), `IMPORT_KINDS` (in `app.models.import_run`); models `AccountGroup`, `Account`, `Category`, `Project`, `Counterparty`, `EntryGroup`, `RewardRule`, `EntryRewardRule`, `LedgerEntry`, `Preference`, `MozeSchedule`, `ImportRun` exactly as in the Interface Contract; `POSTED_DATE_FUNCTION_SQL` / `POSTED_DATE_TRIGGER_SQL` (the trigger `trg_ledger_entry_posted_date` that fills `posted_date` from `entry_date` when NULL on insert or update); `ON DELETE SET NULL` on `settles_entry_id`, `refunds_entry_id`, `reward_source_entry_id` (deleting a settled or refunded entry clears the links, as the entry write spec requires).

Notes for the implementer:
- `posted_date` is `NOT NULL` with no column default; PostgreSQL cannot default one column from another, so a `BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE` trigger fills it. The column is declared with `server_default=FetchedValue()` so the ORM omits it when unset and reloads it after flush. The models attach the same DDL to `after_create`, so `Base.metadata.create_all` (used by `test_models_schema.py`) builds the trigger too; the migration in Task 3 installs identical SQL.
- Between this task's commit and Task 3's commit the integration tests that use `db_session` or `client` fail, because the test database is built by Alembic and the migration does not exist yet. Run only the files named in this task's steps; Task 3.7 runs the full suite. Execute Tasks 2 and 3 back to back.
- `account` keeps no database check for the credit-only fields; that rule is validated by the settings service (Task 16), which must name the offending field in a 422.

```python
"""The ORM models alone (Base.metadata.create_all) build the phase 2a schema.

These tests do not depend on the Alembic migration; test_migration.py checks that the
migration produces the same schema.
"""

import uuid
from datetime import date, datetime, timezone
from decimal import Decimal

import pytest
from sqlalchemy import create_engine, delete, inspect, select, text
from sqlalchemy.exc import IntegrityError
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from app.database import Base
from app.models import (
    Account,
    AccountGroup,
    Category,
    Counterparty,
    EntryGroup,
    EntryRewardRule,
    ImportRun,
    LedgerEntry,
    MozeSchedule,
    Preference,
    Project,
    RewardRule,
)

PHASE_2A_TABLES = {
    "account", "account_group", "category", "counterparty", "entry_group", "entry_reward_rule",
    "fx_rate", "import_run", "ledger_entry", "moze_schedule", "preference", "project", "reward_rule",
}


@pytest.fixture()
def model_engine(database_factory):
    engine = create_engine(database_factory())
    with engine.begin() as conn:
        conn.execute(text("CREATE SEQUENCE ledger_entry_seq_seq AS BIGINT"))
    Base.metadata.create_all(engine)
    try:
        yield engine
    finally:
        engine.dispose()


@pytest.fixture()
def model_session(model_engine):
    with Session(model_engine, autoflush=False) as session:
        yield session


def _wallet(session: Session, **extra) -> Account:
    account = Account(name=extra.pop("name", "錢包"), currency="TWD", **extra)
    session.add(account)
    session.flush()
    return account


def _entry(session: Session, account: Account, amount: str, **extra) -> LedgerEntry:
    entry = LedgerEntry(
        account_id=account.id, kind=extra.pop("kind", "expense"), amount=Decimal(amount), currency=account.currency,
        entry_date=extra.pop("entry_date", date(2026, 10, 1)), source=extra.pop("source", "manual"), **extra,
    )
    session.add(entry)
    session.flush()
    return entry


def test_models_create_every_phase_2a_table(model_engine):
    assert PHASE_2A_TABLES <= set(inspect(model_engine).get_table_names())
    columns = {c["name"] for c in inspect(model_engine).get_columns("ledger_entry")}
    assert "counterparty" not in columns
    assert {
        "posted_date", "counterparty_id", "group_id", "settles_entry_id", "refunds_entry_id", "reward_rule_id",
        "reward_source_entry_id", "invoice_number", "invoice_random", "moze_id", "updated_at", "is_settlement",
    } <= columns


def test_posted_date_defaults_to_entry_date_and_keeps_an_explicit_value(model_session):
    wallet = _wallet(model_session)
    default = _entry(model_session, wallet, "-100", entry_date=date(2026, 9, 30))
    explicit = _entry(model_session, wallet, "50", kind="reward", entry_date=date(2026, 9, 30), posted_date=date(2026, 11, 5))
    model_session.commit()

    assert default.posted_date == date(2026, 9, 30)
    assert explicit.posted_date == date(2026, 11, 5)


def test_new_columns_have_their_defaults(model_session):
    wallet = _wallet(model_session)
    category = Category(kind="expense", name="飲食")
    project = Project(name="生活")
    run = ImportRun(started_at=datetime(2026, 10, 1, tzinfo=timezone.utc), file_name="x.zip", file_sha256="0" * 64, status="running")
    model_session.add_all([category, project, run])
    model_session.commit()

    assert (wallet.sort_order, wallet.include_in_total, wallet.is_credit, wallet.fx_fee_refundable) == (0, True, False, False)
    assert wallet.settings_locally_edited is False
    assert (category.sort_order, category.is_hidden, category.icon, category.color) == (0, False, None, None)
    assert (project.is_archived, project.sort_order) == (False, 0)
    assert (run.kind, run.exported_at) == ("moze_csv", None)


def test_account_check_constraints(model_session):
    wallet = _wallet(model_session)
    model_session.commit()

    wallet.closing_day = 32
    with pytest.raises(IntegrityError, match="ck_account_closing_day"):
        model_session.commit()
    model_session.rollback()

    wallet.combined_account_id = wallet.id
    with pytest.raises(IntegrityError, match="ck_account_combined_not_self"):
        model_session.commit()


def test_new_enum_values_are_accepted(model_session):
    wallet = _wallet(model_session, is_credit=True, due_rule="days_after_closing", fx_fee_rounding="floor")
    entry = _entry(
        model_session, wallet, "-1166", source="moze_backup", moze_id="R-1",
        original_amount=Decimal("-5390"), original_currency="JPY", fx_rate=Decimal("0.2163"), fx_source="manual",
    )
    group = EntryGroup(kind="split", name="聚餐")
    model_session.add_all([group, MozeSchedule(kind="period", moze_id="P-1", payload={"n": 1})])
    model_session.flush()
    entry.group_id = group.id
    model_session.commit()

    assert (entry.source, entry.fx_source, wallet.due_rule) == ("moze_backup", "manual", "days_after_closing")


def test_rule_attachment_cascades_with_the_entry_and_protects_the_rule(model_session):
    card = _wallet(model_session, name="玉山 UNI", is_credit=True)
    rule = RewardRule(account_id=card.id, name="國內 1%", method="percent", rate=Decimal("1"), posting="after_window")
    model_session.add(rule)
    model_session.flush()
    entry = _entry(model_session, card, "-1000")
    model_session.add(EntryRewardRule(entry_id=entry.id, rule_id=rule.id))
    model_session.commit()

    assert (rule.window, rule.txn_rounding, rule.total_rounding, rule.is_enabled) == ("statement_cycle", "keep", "keep", True)
    with pytest.raises(IntegrityError):
        model_session.execute(delete(RewardRule).where(RewardRule.id == rule.id))
    model_session.rollback()

    model_session.execute(delete(LedgerEntry).where(LedgerEntry.id == entry.id))
    model_session.commit()
    assert model_session.scalar(select(EntryRewardRule)) is None


def test_deleting_a_settled_target_clears_the_link(model_session):
    wallet = _wallet(model_session)
    alan = Counterparty(name="Alan")
    model_session.add(alan)
    model_session.flush()
    receivable = _entry(model_session, wallet, "-420", kind="receivable", counterparty_id=alan.id)
    collection = _entry(
        model_session, wallet, "200", kind="receivable", counterparty_id=alan.id, settles_entry_id=receivable.id,
        is_settlement=True,
    )
    model_session.commit()

    model_session.execute(delete(LedgerEntry).where(LedgerEntry.id == receivable.id))
    model_session.commit()
    model_session.refresh(collection)
    assert collection.settles_entry_id is None


def test_settlement_sign_requires_is_settlement(model_session):
    wallet = _wallet(model_session)
    model_session.commit()

    # A positive receivable (收款) is a settlement; without the flag the check rejects it.
    with pytest.raises(IntegrityError, match="ck_ledger_entry_settlement_sign"):
        _entry(model_session, wallet, "200", kind="receivable")  # _entry flushes
    model_session.rollback()

    collection = _entry(model_session, wallet, "200", kind="receivable", is_settlement=True)
    model_session.commit()
    assert collection.is_settlement is True
    assert _entry(model_session, wallet, "-50", kind="receivable").is_settlement is False

    # Only receivable and payable rows may carry the flag.
    with pytest.raises(IntegrityError, match="ck_ledger_entry_settlement_sign"):
        _entry(model_session, wallet, "-80", kind="expense", is_settlement=True)


def test_preference_is_a_single_row_with_defaults(model_session):
    model_session.add(Preference())
    model_session.commit()
    pref = model_session.get(Preference, 1)
    assert (pref.expense_income_colors, pref.keypad_layout, pref.week_start, pref.main_currency) == ("red_green", "calculator", 0, "TWD")
    assert (pref.hide_rewards_on_timeline, pref.abbreviate_totals) == (False, True)

    model_session.add(Preference(id=2))
    with pytest.raises(IntegrityError, match="ck_preference_single_row"):
        model_session.commit()


def test_group_and_counterparty_names_are_unique(model_session):
    model_session.add_all([AccountGroup(name="信用卡"), AccountGroup(name="信用卡")])
    with pytest.raises(IntegrityError):
        model_session.commit()
    model_session.rollback()

    model_session.add_all([Counterparty(name="Alan", moze_id=str(uuid.uuid4())), Counterparty(name="Alan")])
    with pytest.raises(IntegrityError):
        model_session.commit()
```

- Test: `services/accounting-service/tests/integration/test_migration.py` (new constants and six tests), `services/accounting-service/tests/integration/test_ledger_model.py` (posted-date trigger on the migrated schema)

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: the Task 2 models (the migration must produce exactly the schema `Base.metadata.create_all` produces), phase 1 revision `5d2e7c9a1b3f`.
- Produces: Alembic head `7b1e4a2c9d05`; enum values `entry_source` + `moze_backup`, `rule`; `fx_source` + `manual`; new enum types `due_rule`, `rounding_mode`, `entry_group_kind`, `reward_method`, `reward_window`, `reward_posting`, `color_convention`, `keypad_layout`, `moze_schedule_kind`, `import_kind`; `counterparty` rows migrated from the phase 1 text column; `ledger_entry.is_settlement` back-filled from the sign of phase 1 receivable/payable rows and the check `ck_ledger_entry_settlement_sign`; `conftest.LEDGER_TABLES` covering every ledger table (including `preference`); a strict downgrade guard whose single `RuntimeError` lists every blocker it found, with a count per label. Rollback after a successful 2a deploy is restore-from-dump (Task 30), not `alembic downgrade`.

Notes for the implementer:
- `ALTER TYPE … ADD VALUE IF NOT EXISTS` runs inside the migration transaction (allowed since PostgreSQL 12; the server is 16.13). A value added this way cannot be *used* before the transaction commits, and `upgrade()` never uses the new values, so no `autocommit_block()` is needed. If a later migration needs to insert `moze_backup` rows in the same run, it must wrap the `ADD VALUE` in `op.get_context().autocommit_block()`.
- `downgrade()` refuses (raises `RuntimeError`, nothing changes because the migration is transactional) when phase 1 cannot hold the data: any `ledger_entry` whose `source` is `manual`, `hermes`, `rule` or `moze_backup` (one count per source), any `fx_source = 'manual'`, any `posted_date <> entry_date`, any new link column set, any row in `account_group`, `entry_group`, `reward_rule`, `entry_reward_rule`, `moze_schedule`, any `moze_backup` import run, any account with `settings_locally_edited` or a `moze_id`, any category or project with a `moze_id`, any counterparty with a `moze_id` or without entries. The guard runs every check before raising, so one `RuntimeError` names all blockers with their counts (for example `1 ledger_entry rows with source = moze_backup; 1 reward_rule rows`); it never stops at the first. Otherwise it restores `ledger_entry.counterparty` from `counterparty.name`, drops the new objects and recreates `entry_source` / `fx_source` with their phase 1 values. Display-only columns (account icons, category colours, `preference`) are dropped without a guard.

```python
def _models_schema(url) -> dict:
    """Schema built by Base.metadata.create_all (plus the sequence the models reference)."""
    from app.database import Base

    engine = create_engine(url)
    try:
        with engine.begin() as conn:
            conn.execute(text("CREATE SEQUENCE ledger_entry_seq_seq AS BIGINT"))
        Base.metadata.create_all(engine)
    finally:
        engine.dispose()
    schema = _schema(url)
    schema["tables"] = [t for t in schema["tables"] if t != "alembic_version"]
    return schema


def _phase_1_rows(url) -> None:
    engine = create_engine(url)
    with engine.begin() as conn:
        account_id = conn.execute(
            text("INSERT INTO account (name, currency) VALUES ('錢包', 'TWD') RETURNING id")
        ).scalar_one()
        for day, counterparty in ((1, "Alan"), (2, "Alan"), (3, "Alan"), (4, "Bob"), (5, None)):
            conn.execute(
                text(
                    "INSERT INTO ledger_entry (account_id, kind, amount, currency, entry_date, counterparty, source) "
                    "VALUES (:a, 'receivable', -100, 'TWD', :d, :c, 'moze_import')"
                ),
                {"a": account_id, "d": f"2026-09-0{day}", "c": counterparty},
            )
    engine.dispose()


def test_head_schema_matches_the_models(database_factory, alembic_config):
    migrated = database_factory()
    command.upgrade(alembic_config(migrated), "head")
    schema = _schema(migrated)
    schema["tables"] = [t for t in schema["tables"] if t != "alembic_version"]

    assert schema == _models_schema(database_factory())


def test_upgrade_backfills_posted_date_and_links_counterparties(database_factory, alembic_config):
    url = database_factory()
    config = alembic_config(url)
    command.upgrade(config, PHASE_1_HEAD)
    _phase_1_rows(url)

    command.upgrade(config, "head")

    engine = create_engine(url)
    with engine.connect() as conn:
        counterparties = dict(conn.execute(text("SELECT name, id FROM counterparty")).all())
        links = conn.execute(
            text("SELECT counterparty_id, count(*) FROM ledger_entry GROUP BY counterparty_id")
        ).all()
        mismatched = conn.execute(text("SELECT count(*) FROM ledger_entry WHERE posted_date <> entry_date")).scalar_one()
    engine.dispose()
    assert sorted(counterparties) == ["Alan", "Bob"]
    assert sorted(links, key=lambda row: (row[0] is None, row[0])) == sorted(
        [(counterparties["Alan"], 3), (counterparties["Bob"], 1), (None, 1)],
        key=lambda row: (row[0] is None, row[0]),
    )
    assert mismatched == 0


def test_upgrade_backfills_is_settlement_for_phase_1_collections(database_factory, alembic_config):
    url = database_factory()
    config = alembic_config(url)
    command.upgrade(config, PHASE_1_HEAD)
    engine = create_engine(url)
    with engine.begin() as conn:
        account_id = conn.execute(
            text("INSERT INTO account (name, currency) VALUES ('錢包', 'TWD') RETURNING id")
        ).scalar_one()
        # Phase 1 CSV rows: 借出 (-420), 收款 (+200), 借入 (+300), 還款 (-100), an expense.
        for kind, amount in (("receivable", -420), ("receivable", 200), ("payable", 300), ("payable", -100), ("expense", -60)):
            conn.execute(
                text(
                    "INSERT INTO ledger_entry (account_id, kind, amount, currency, entry_date, source) "
                    "VALUES (:a, :k, :m, 'TWD', '2026-09-01', 'moze_import')"
                ),
                {"a": account_id, "k": kind, "m": amount},
            )
    engine.dispose()

    command.upgrade(config, "head")

    engine = create_engine(url)
    with engine.connect() as conn:
        flags = conn.execute(
            text("SELECT kind::text, amount::int, is_settlement FROM ledger_entry ORDER BY id")
        ).all()
    with pytest.raises(IntegrityError, match="ck_ledger_entry_settlement_sign"), engine.begin() as conn:
        conn.execute(
            text(
                "INSERT INTO ledger_entry (account_id, kind, amount, currency, entry_date, source) "
                "VALUES (:a, 'receivable', 50, 'TWD', '2026-09-02', 'manual')"
            ),
            {"a": account_id},
        )
    engine.dispose()
    assert flags == [
        ("receivable", -420, False), ("receivable", 200, True), ("payable", 300, False),
        ("payable", -100, True), ("expense", -60, False),
    ]


def test_downgrade_restores_phase_1_schema_and_counterparty_text(database_factory, alembic_config):
    reference = database_factory()
    command.upgrade(alembic_config(reference), PHASE_1_HEAD)

    url = database_factory()
    config = alembic_config(url)
    command.upgrade(config, PHASE_1_HEAD)
    _phase_1_rows(url)
    command.upgrade(config, "head")
    command.downgrade(config, PHASE_1_HEAD)

    assert _version(url) == PHASE_1_HEAD
    assert _schema(url) == _schema(reference)
    engine = create_engine(url)
    with engine.connect() as conn:
        restored = conn.execute(
            text("SELECT counterparty, count(*) FROM ledger_entry GROUP BY counterparty ORDER BY counterparty")
        ).all()
        sources = conn.execute(
            text("SELECT enum_range(NULL::entry_source)::text, enum_range(NULL::fx_source)::text")
        ).one()
    engine.dispose()
    assert restored == [("Alan", 3), ("Bob", 1), (None, 1)]
    assert sources == ("{moze_import,manual,hermes}", "{fx_api,moze_backup}")


def test_downgrade_refuses_when_phase_2a_data_exists(database_factory, alembic_config):
    url = database_factory()
    config = alembic_config(url)
    command.upgrade(config, "head")
    engine = create_engine(url)
    with engine.begin() as conn:
        account_id = conn.execute(
            text("INSERT INTO account (name, currency) VALUES ('錢包', 'TWD') RETURNING id")
        ).scalar_one()
        conn.execute(
            text(
                "INSERT INTO ledger_entry (account_id, kind, amount, currency, entry_date, posted_date, source) "
                "VALUES (:a, 'reward', 30, 'TWD', '2026-10-01', '2026-11-05', 'manual')"
            ),
            {"a": account_id},
        )
        conn.execute(text("INSERT INTO account_group (name) VALUES ('信用卡')"))
    engine.dispose()

    with pytest.raises(RuntimeError) as excinfo:
        command.downgrade(config, PHASE_1_HEAD)

    message = str(excinfo.value)
    assert "1 ledger_entry rows with source = manual" in message
    assert "1 ledger_entry rows whose posted_date differs from entry_date" in message
    assert "1 account_group rows" in message
    assert _version(url) == "7b1e4a2c9d05"


def test_downgrade_refusal_names_every_blocker(database_factory, alembic_config):
    url = database_factory()
    config = alembic_config(url)
    command.upgrade(config, "head")
    engine = create_engine(url)
    with engine.begin() as conn:
        account_id = conn.execute(
            text("INSERT INTO account (name, currency) VALUES ('錢包', 'TWD') RETURNING id")
        ).scalar_one()
        conn.execute(
            text(
                "INSERT INTO ledger_entry (account_id, kind, amount, currency, entry_date, source) "
                "VALUES (:a, 'expense', -60, 'TWD', '2026-09-01', 'moze_backup')"
            ),
            {"a": account_id},
        )
        conn.execute(
            text(
                "INSERT INTO reward_rule (account_id, name, method, rate, posting) "
                "VALUES (:a, '國內 1%', 'percent', 1, 'after_window')"
            ),
            {"a": account_id},
        )
    engine.dispose()

    with pytest.raises(RuntimeError) as excinfo:
        command.downgrade(config, PHASE_1_HEAD)

    message = str(excinfo.value)
    assert message.startswith("refusing to downgrade 7b1e4a2c9d05: phase 1 cannot hold ")
    assert "1 ledger_entry rows with source = moze_backup" in message
    assert "1 reward_rule rows" in message
    assert "source = manual" not in message
    assert _version(url) == "7b1e4a2c9d05"
```

```python
def test_migrated_posted_date_follows_entry_date_unless_given(db_session):
    # The migration installs the same trigger as the models (D14).
    wallet = Account(name="錢包", currency="TWD")
    db_session.add(wallet)
    db_session.flush()
    plain = LedgerEntry(account_id=wallet.id, kind="expense", amount=Decimal("-1"), currency="TWD",
                        entry_date=date(2026, 9, 30), source="manual")
    later = LedgerEntry(account_id=wallet.id, kind="reward", amount=Decimal("5"), currency="TWD",
                        entry_date=date(2026, 9, 30), posted_date=date(2026, 11, 5), source="manual")
    db_session.add_all([plain, later])
    db_session.commit()

    assert (plain.posted_date, later.posted_date) == (date(2026, 9, 30), date(2026, 11, 5))
    plain.posted_date = None
    db_session.commit()
    assert plain.posted_date == date(2026, 9, 30)
```

```python
"""phase 2a: settings, groups, counterparties, reward rules, preference, posting date

Revision ID: 7b1e4a2c9d05
Revises: 5d2e7c9a1b3f
Create Date: 2026-10-02 12:00:00.000000

"""

from typing import Sequence, Union

from alembic import op
import sqlalchemy as sa
from sqlalchemy.dialects import postgresql


revision: str = "7b1e4a2c9d05"
down_revision: Union[str, Sequence[str], None] = "5d2e7c9a1b3f"
branch_labels: Union[str, Sequence[str], None] = None
depends_on: Union[str, Sequence[str], None] = None

# Values this revision adds to enums created by 5d2e7c9a1b3f. ADD VALUE runs inside the
# migration transaction (PostgreSQL 12+ allows it); nothing in upgrade() uses the new values,
# so no autocommit block is needed.
PHASE_1_ENTRY_SOURCES = ("moze_import", "manual", "hermes")
PHASE_1_FX_SOURCES = ("fx_api", "moze_backup")
ADDED_ENTRY_SOURCES = ("moze_backup", "rule")
ADDED_FX_SOURCES = ("manual",)

NEW_ENUMS = {
    "due_rule": ("fixed_day", "days_after_closing"),
    "rounding_mode": ("keep", "round", "floor", "ceil"),
    "entry_group_kind": ("split", "reward_claim", "installment"),
    "reward_method": ("percent", "fixed"),
    "reward_window": ("statement_cycle",),
    "reward_posting": ("after_window", "after_transaction", "manual"),
    "color_convention": ("red_green", "green_red"),
    "keypad_layout": ("calculator", "phone"),
    "moze_schedule_kind": ("period", "installment", "skipped_record"),
    "import_kind": ("moze_csv", "moze_backup"),
}


def _enum(name: str) -> postgresql.ENUM:
    return postgresql.ENUM(*NEW_ENUMS[name], name=name, create_type=False)


POSTED_DATE_FUNCTION_SQL = """
CREATE FUNCTION ledger_entry_default_posted_date() RETURNS trigger AS $$
BEGIN
    IF NEW.posted_date IS NULL THEN
        NEW.posted_date := NEW.entry_date;
    END IF;
    RETURN NEW;
END;
$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql
"""
POSTED_DATE_TRIGGER_SQL = """
CREATE TRIGGER trg_ledger_entry_posted_date
BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE ON ledger_entry
FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION ledger_entry_default_posted_date()
"""

# Same text as app.models.ledger.SETTLEMENT_SIGN_SQL (migrations do not import app code).
SETTLEMENT_SIGN_SQL = (
    "(is_settlement OR NOT ((kind = 'receivable' AND amount > 0) OR (kind = 'payable' AND amount < 0)))"
    " AND (NOT is_settlement OR kind IN ('receivable', 'payable'))"
)

NEW_ENTRY_COLUMNS = (
    "group_id", "settles_entry_id", "refunds_entry_id", "reward_rule_id", "reward_source_entry_id",
    "invoice_number", "invoice_random", "moze_id",
)

# Each check returns a count; any non-zero count blocks the downgrade because phase 1 cannot hold that data.
# _assert_downgradable runs all of them and raises one RuntimeError listing every non-zero count.
DOWNGRADE_GUARDS = {
    # One label per source phase 1 must not receive, so the message says what kind of rows block it.
    "ledger_entry rows with source = manual": "SELECT count(*) FROM ledger_entry WHERE source = 'manual'",
    "ledger_entry rows with source = hermes": "SELECT count(*) FROM ledger_entry WHERE source = 'hermes'",
    "ledger_entry rows with source = rule": "SELECT count(*) FROM ledger_entry WHERE source = 'rule'",
    "ledger_entry rows with source = moze_backup": "SELECT count(*) FROM ledger_entry WHERE source = 'moze_backup'",
    "ledger_entry rows with fx_source = manual":
        "SELECT count(*) FROM ledger_entry WHERE fx_source = 'manual'",
    "ledger_entry rows whose posted_date differs from entry_date":
        "SELECT count(*) FROM ledger_entry WHERE posted_date <> entry_date",
    "ledger_entry rows using phase 2a link columns":
        "SELECT count(*) FROM ledger_entry WHERE "
        + " OR ".join(f"{column} IS NOT NULL" for column in NEW_ENTRY_COLUMNS),
    "account_group rows": "SELECT count(*) FROM account_group",
    "entry_group rows": "SELECT count(*) FROM entry_group",
    "reward_rule rows": "SELECT count(*) FROM reward_rule",
    "entry_reward_rule rows": "SELECT count(*) FROM entry_reward_rule",
    "moze_schedule rows": "SELECT count(*) FROM moze_schedule",
    "moze_backup import_run rows": "SELECT count(*) FROM import_run WHERE kind = 'moze_backup'",
    "accounts with locally edited settings or a moze_id":
        "SELECT count(*) FROM account WHERE settings_locally_edited OR moze_id IS NOT NULL",
    "categories or projects with a moze_id":
        "SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM category WHERE moze_id IS NOT NULL)"
        " + (SELECT count(*) FROM project WHERE moze_id IS NOT NULL)",
    "counterparties with a moze_id or without entries":
        "SELECT count(*) FROM counterparty c WHERE c.moze_id IS NOT NULL"
        " OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ledger_entry e WHERE e.counterparty_id = c.id)",
}


def upgrade() -> None:
    connection = op.get_bind()
    for value in ADDED_ENTRY_SOURCES:
        op.execute(f"ALTER TYPE entry_source ADD VALUE IF NOT EXISTS '{value}'")
    for value in ADDED_FX_SOURCES:
        op.execute(f"ALTER TYPE fx_source ADD VALUE IF NOT EXISTS '{value}'")
    for name, values in NEW_ENUMS.items():
        postgresql.ENUM(*values, name=name).create(connection)

    op.create_table(
        "account_group",
        sa.Column("id", sa.Integer(), primary_key=True),
        sa.Column("name", sa.String(64), nullable=False, unique=True),
        sa.Column("sort_order", sa.Integer(), nullable=False, server_default=sa.text("0")),
        sa.Column("moze_id", sa.String(64), nullable=True, unique=True),
    )
    op.create_table(
        "counterparty",
        sa.Column("id", sa.Integer(), primary_key=True),
        sa.Column("name", sa.String(128), nullable=False, unique=True),
        sa.Column("moze_id", sa.String(64), nullable=True, unique=True),
    )
    op.create_table(
        "entry_group",
        sa.Column("id", sa.Integer(), primary_key=True),
        sa.Column("kind", _enum("entry_group_kind"), nullable=False),
        sa.Column("name", sa.String(128), nullable=True),
        sa.Column("merchant", sa.String(128), nullable=True),
        sa.Column("description", sa.Text(), nullable=True),
        sa.Column("moze_id", sa.String(64), nullable=True, unique=True),
        sa.Column("created_at", sa.DateTime(timezone=True), nullable=False, server_default=sa.text("now()")),
    )
    op.create_table(
        "preference",
        sa.Column("id", sa.Integer(), primary_key=True, autoincrement=False, server_default=sa.text("1")),
        sa.Column("expense_income_colors", _enum("color_convention"), nullable=False, server_default=sa.text("'red_green'")),
        sa.Column("keypad_layout", _enum("keypad_layout"), nullable=False, server_default=sa.text("'calculator'")),
        sa.Column("week_start", sa.SmallInteger(), nullable=False, server_default=sa.text("0")),
        sa.Column("main_currency", sa.String(8), nullable=False, server_default=sa.text("'TWD'")),
        sa.Column("hide_rewards_on_timeline", sa.Boolean(), nullable=False, server_default=sa.text("false")),
        sa.Column("abbreviate_totals", sa.Boolean(), nullable=False, server_default=sa.text("true")),
        sa.CheckConstraint("id = 1", name="ck_preference_single_row"),
        sa.CheckConstraint("week_start BETWEEN 0 AND 6", name="ck_preference_week_start"),
    )

    op.add_column("account", sa.Column("group_id", sa.Integer(), sa.ForeignKey("account_group.id"), nullable=True))
    op.add_column("account", sa.Column("icon", sa.String(16), nullable=True))
    op.add_column("account", sa.Column("color", sa.String(9), nullable=True))
    op.add_column("account", sa.Column("note", sa.Text(), nullable=True))
    op.add_column("account", sa.Column("sort_order", sa.Integer(), nullable=False, server_default=sa.text("0")))
    op.add_column("account", sa.Column("include_in_total", sa.Boolean(), nullable=False, server_default=sa.text("true")))
    op.add_column("account", sa.Column("is_credit", sa.Boolean(), nullable=False, server_default=sa.text("false")))
    op.add_column("account", sa.Column("closing_day", sa.SmallInteger(), nullable=True))
    op.add_column("account", sa.Column("due_rule", _enum("due_rule"), nullable=True))
    op.add_column("account", sa.Column("due_value", sa.SmallInteger(), nullable=True))
    op.add_column("account", sa.Column("credit_limit", sa.Numeric(20, 4), nullable=True))
    op.add_column("account", sa.Column("combined_account_id", sa.Integer(), sa.ForeignKey("account.id"), nullable=True))
    op.add_column("account", sa.Column("credit_sharing_id", sa.Uuid(), nullable=True))

    op.add_column("account", sa.Column("fx_fee_pct", sa.Numeric(6, 3), nullable=True))
    op.add_column("account", sa.Column("fx_fee_rounding", _enum("rounding_mode"), nullable=True))
    op.add_column("account", sa.Column("fx_fee_refundable", sa.Boolean(), nullable=False, server_default=sa.text("false")))
    op.add_column("account", sa.Column("settings_locally_edited", sa.Boolean(), nullable=False, server_default=sa.text("false")))
    op.add_column("account", sa.Column("moze_id", sa.String(64), nullable=True))

    op.create_check_constraint("ck_account_combined_not_self", "account", "combined_account_id <> id")

    op.add_column("category", sa.Column("icon", sa.String(16), nullable=True))

def _assert_downgradable(connection: sa.Connection) -> None:
    blockers = []
    for label, sql in DOWNGRADE_GUARDS.items():
        count = connection.execute(sa.text(sql)).scalar_one()
        if count:
            blockers.append(f"{count} {label}")
    if blockers:
        raise RuntimeError("refusing to downgrade 7b1e4a2c9d05: phase 1 cannot hold " + "; ".join(blockers))


def _shrink_enum(table: str, column: str, type_name: str, values: tuple[str, ...]) -> None:
    """PostgreSQL cannot drop enum values: recreate the type with the phase 1 values."""
    op.execute(f"ALTER TYPE {type_name} RENAME TO {type_name}_2a")
    op.execute(f"CREATE TYPE {type_name} AS ENUM ({', '.join(repr(v) for v in values)})")
    op.execute(f"ALTER TABLE {table} ALTER COLUMN {column} TYPE {type_name} USING {column}::text::{type_name}")
    op.execute(f"DROP TYPE {type_name}_2a")


def downgrade() -> None:
    connection = op.get_bind()
    for table in ("ledger_entry", "account", "category", "project", "counterparty", "import_run"):
        op.execute(f'LOCK TABLE "{table}" IN ACCESS EXCLUSIVE MODE')
    _assert_downgradable(connection)

    op.drop_table("moze_schedule")
    op.drop_table("entry_reward_rule")

    op.add_column("ledger_entry", sa.Column("counterparty", sa.String(128), nullable=True))
    op.execute("UPDATE ledger_entry e SET counterparty = c.name FROM counterparty c WHERE c.id = e.counterparty_id")
    op.create_index("ix_ledger_entry_counterparty", "ledger_entry", ["counterparty"])

    # is_settlement is derivable from kind and sign for every row phase 1 can hold, so no guard.
    op.drop_constraint("ck_ledger_entry_settlement_sign", "ledger_entry", type_="check")
    op.drop_column("ledger_entry", "is_settlement")

    op.execute("DROP TRIGGER trg_ledger_entry_posted_date ON ledger_entry")
    op.execute("DROP FUNCTION ledger_entry_default_posted_date()")
    for index in (
        "ix_ledger_entry_reward_source_entry_id",
        "ix_ledger_entry_settles_entry_id",
        "ix_ledger_entry_group_id",
        "ix_ledger_entry_counterparty_id",
        "ix_ledger_entry_entry_date",
        "ix_ledger_entry_account_posted",
    ):
        op.drop_index(index, table_name="ledger_entry")
    for column in (
        "updated_at", "moze_id", "invoice_random", "invoice_number", "reward_source_entry_id", "reward_rule_id",
        "refunds_entry_id", "settles_entry_id", "group_id", "counterparty_id", "posted_date",
    ):
        op.drop_column("ledger_entry", column)

    op.drop_index("ix_reward_rule_account_id", table_name="reward_rule")
    op.drop_table("reward_rule")

    op.drop_column("import_run", "exported_at")
    op.drop_column("import_run", "kind")
    for column in ("moze_id", "sort_order", "is_archived"):
        op.drop_column("project", column)
    for column in ("moze_id", "default_project_id", "default_account_id", "is_hidden", "sort_order", "color", "icon"):
        op.drop_column("category", column)
    op.drop_constraint("ck_account_combined_not_self", "account", type_="check")
    op.drop_constraint("ck_account_closing_day", "account", type_="check")
    for column in (
        "moze_id", "settings_locally_edited", "fx_fee_refundable", "fx_fee_rounding", "fx_fee_pct",
        "auto_pay_account_id", "credit_sharing_id", "combined_account_id", "credit_limit", "due_value", "due_rule",
        "closing_day", "is_credit", "include_in_total", "sort_order", "note", "color", "icon", "group_id",
    ):
        op.drop_column("account", column)

    op.drop_table("preference")
    op.drop_table("entry_group")
    op.drop_table("counterparty")
    op.drop_table("account_group")
    for name in reversed(list(NEW_ENUMS)):
        op.execute(f"DROP TYPE {name}")

    _shrink_enum("ledger_entry", "source", "entry_source", PHASE_1_ENTRY_SOURCES)
```

**Files:**
